Not published on hex; built from the repository with Erlang/OTP 24 (it uses http_uri, removed in OTP 25).
Errors are returned as {"code": …, "fieldValue": …} objects instead of plain error codes (the library adds the invalid value to every error), so only the codes are compared.
Installed with the optional lrexlib-pcre2 and luautf8 rocks, which the `like` rule and Unicode-aware to_lc/to_uc need.
